author: Fur (TheFur)
notes: The whole map is 56 trigger_teleports, 48 destinations and worldspawn -- there is no other entity in the file, so there is nothing to read a label off. What it does have is a completely regular teleport graph, and the finish falls straight out of it. All 32 spawns sit on the destination `Stage1`, and exactly two triggers are aimed at it: a 2560x1536x16 pad, which is the floor under the start platform, and a 16x448x352 plane standing 23125 units away at the far end of the map. A 16-unit-thick wall at the opposite corner that sends you back to the start line is a finish line -- the same door-versus-pit measurement surf_kitsune needed, and here the two differ by a factor of five in width with nothing between them. Stage2..Stage31 are not emitted as splits: they are where each section returns a player who fell, and the map also carries LJ1..LJ12, Telehop1/2 and StageBonus in the same namespace, so numbering them would put a different set of splits on a run depending on which practice area a player wandered into.
